description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.48.0-dualvot.8.5.4

Fix Yandex player event runtime compatibility. Java player events no longer link to Kotlin Unit or Function1; legacy Kotlin player events retain an isolated compatibility adapter. Preserve playback pause/resume and PiP observer removal.

Regression tests cover Java events with Kotlin entirely unavailable, legacy events and listener removal. Android device confirmation is pending.
